exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. cesarean section)
mother felt follow-up was unnecessary because newborn was healthy
cohort: 972 mother-newborn dyads at Tygerberg Hospital in Cape Town, South Africa, enrolled from November 2014 to April 2015
finding: This study found that nearly 4 in 5 newborns were seen at a clinic within one week after hospital discharge, with higher maternal education level and preterm birth being associated with increased likelihood of follow-up.
mod_finding: The follow-up rate did not differ based on hospital length of stay after vaginal vs. cesarean delivery.
